name: Streamlit Dev Container
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; pip3 install --user --upgrade 'setuptools>=83.0.0'; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
postCreateCommand: python3 -m compileall app.py && echo '✅ Mark My Words compiles cleanly'
